content_sections.heading: About Innovsource Services
content_sections.text: M/s Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd is a private company. The notice is issued by its Supervisor for deploying staff at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi, Visakhapatnam. This is a private engagement through the company, not a notice of a government department.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Technician (Transfusion Medicine), with 2 vacancies. The number of posts is likely to increase or decrease as per the requirement of the centre. Diploma in DMLT or Transfusion Medicine or Blood Bank Technology after 10+2, with one-year experience in the testing of blood and/or its components in a licensed Blood Centre. OR Degree in M.L.T. or Blood Bank Technology, with six months experience in the testing of blood and/or its components in a licensed Blood Centre. OR B.Sc. in Hematology and Transfusion Medicine, with six months experience in the testing of blood and/or its components in a licensed Blood Centre. OR M.Sc. in Transfusion Medicine, with six months experience in the testing of blood and/or its components in a licensed Blood Centre. OR P.G.D in M.L.T, with six months experience in the testing of blood and/or its components in a licensed Blood Centre. Experience is reckoned on post qualification only. The notice states the age limit as 35 Years. It prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation.

rows.qualification: Any one of the qualification routes listed below

content_sections.heading: Salary and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure of the post is a fixed period of six months from the date of joining and is further extendable as per requirement. The notice describes the posts as purely temporary. Candidates must be willing to work in shift duties including nights, Sundays and Holidays.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Updated resume. Recent passport size photograph. Photocopy of PAN card and Aadhar card. All original certificates. One set of self-attested copies of all certificates. One set of Xerox copies of Education and Experience/Relieving certificates and the last 3 months payslip. Candidates without the original certificates and the set of copies will strictly not be allowed to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of posts is likely to increase or decrease as per the requirement of the centre. Candidates should be ready to provide any additional employment proof documents if required before or after the interview. Interested candidates report at the HRD Department, first floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Research Centre, Visakhapatnam. For any query, call 0891-2871 (Extn- 538).

faq.question: Q1. When is the Innovsource Services walk-in interview for Technician (Transfusion Medicine)?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16.11.2026 (16 November 2026) between 9:30 AM and 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: At the HRD Department, first floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Research Centre, Visakhapatnam. The posts are for deployment at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi, Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q3. How many Technician (Transfusion Medicine) posts are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts. The notice says the number may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the centre.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Technician (Transfusion Medicine)?
faq.answer: A Diploma in DMLT, Transfusion Medicine or Blood Bank Technology after 10+2 with one-year experience, or a Degree in M.L.T. or Blood Bank Technology, B.Sc. in Hematology and Transfusion Medicine, M.Sc. in Transfusion Medicine or P.G.D in M.L.T with six months experience in testing of blood and/or its components in a licensed Blood Centre.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as 35 Years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 24,260/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must I bring?
faq.answer: Bring an updated resume, a recent passport size photograph, photocopies of PAN card and Aadhar card, all original certificates, one set of self-attested copies, and Xerox copies of education and experience/relieving certificates and the last 3 months payslip.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls the posts purely temporary, with a fixed tenure of six months from the date of joining, further extendable as per requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Will I have to work in shifts?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be willing to work in shift duties including nights, Sundays and Holidays.

faq.question: Q10. Who can I call for queries?
faq.answer: The notice gives the number 0891-2871 (Extn- 538) for any query.
